DaySlice

Make this turn yours.

See a day as one turn of Earth. A gentle visualization of time, with daily check-ins, widgets, and the weather.

A water clock, a sundial, a 100-square map of the year. DaySlice gives time a visible shape, so you can notice where you are in your day and year. Opening the app checks in automatically, and widgets keep today close.

A few useful answers

Do I have to share my location?+

No. Tokyo is the default weather location. Permission is requested only if you choose local weather, and location is never stored.

How do daily check-ins work?+

Your first launch each day automatically checks you in. Records stay on your device.

What does the Earth rotation count mean?+

It expresses the civil-day count since January 1, year 1 as Earth rotations. It is a calendar-based visualization, not a measurement of Earth’s physical rotation.

Data & privacy

No account or ads. Check-ins stay on your device. Location is optional and is never stored.

Read the App Store description

How many times has Earth turned today?

DaySlice is a gentle way to see time—not as something to chase, but as a day worth noticing.

Open the app and today is checked in automatically. See the civil-day count since January 1, year 1 as Earth rotations, watch today unfold, and discover where you are in the week, month, quarter and year.

SEE TODAY AT A GLANCE
• Earth rotation count since 0001-01-01
• Day progress shown as a water clock, sundial or balance
• Day of year, 100-square year map and days remaining
• Moon age, seasons and an approximation of Earth’s orbit

REMEMBER THE DAYS YOU SHOWED UP
• Automatic daily check-in on first launch
• A monthly calendar of the days you opened DaySlice
• A thoughtful quote for each day

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Keep Earth rotations and your position in the year visible with beautiful widgets.

WEATHER IN THE SAME DAILY VIEW
See current conditions, temperature, hourly forecasts and rain probability from Apple Weather. Tokyo works by default; local weather is optional and requested only when you choose it.

No account. No ads. Check-ins stay on your device, and location is never stored.

Earth is turning today. Make this turn yours.
